units.description: Chariot Retinue have halberd and shield. Open Order. Superior Fighters. Escorts.  May have light armour (+2). May exchange halberd for spear (-2). May be fielded as Skirmishers at a cost of eleven points per base.

units.name: Royal Guard

units.name: Warriors
units.description: Warriors have a shield. May have light armour (+2). May have spear (free) or exchange shield for bow or halberd (free).
